notes.title: Concordia: Digital Edition Update v1.3.6 is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/e0ace360f2922c2c907f72dcd1b168658d089d37.jpg[/img]

We’ve just released [b]version 1.3.6[/b], focusing on bug fixes based on your helpful feedback. ✨

[Fix] Resolved an issue preventing card purchases when the Magister card was played on the Consul or Senator.
[Fix] Fixed a softlock occurring after playing the Diplomat card on the Magister.
[Fix] Implemented minor stability improvements.

And while you're here, we’ve got exciting news: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924580][b]Inkborn[/b][/url], a roguelike deckbuilder, which is our first original game project (not a digital adaptation of board game) is set to release on [b]Early Access in Q2 2025[/b]! 🖤🖋️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924580

What sets [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924580][b]Inkborn[/b][/url] apart? 🃏
[b]Inkborn[/b] introduces an innovative card combo system, where players unlock powerful moves by sequencing cards strategically - bringing the excitement of classic fighting game combos into a fresh and unique twist. Combined with our distinctive Origami-inspired art style and a dynamic roster of evolving character classes, every run offers a new and exciting experience. At launch, you'll have access to over 100 different cards to experiment with, and we’re just getting started - expect more characters and cards to be added post-launch! [b]Full Release[/b] 👉 [b]Q2 2026[/b].

Make sure to update [b]Concordia: Digital Edition[/b] to enjoy the latest improvements, and as always, let us know if you encounter anything else! 🎮

notes.title: Concordia: Digital Edition Update v1.3.3 is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/91c5bbb00a3d7839447cde066c58997c20fce22c.png[/img]
[b]Update 1.3.3 for Concordia: Digital Edition is now live![/b] Based on your feedback, we've made improvements to enhance the app's functionality. This update primarily addresses bugs and issues reported by our dedicated community. 🥳

In addition, we've added [b]24 new Steam achievements[/b], offering new challenges and rewards for players to discover as they continue exploring the game. Enjoy these new features and dive back into [b]Concordia: Digital Edition[/b]! Check out one of the most interesting:
[list]
[*][b]Cedant arma togae, concedant laurea laudi[/b] (Win against hard AI opponent without deploying any Colonists from the Storehouse.)
[*][b]Pecunia non olet[/b] (Own at least 50 Sestertii at the end of your turn.)
[*][b]Alii sementem faciunt, alii metunt[/b] (Gain at least 2 Goods during an opponent's Prefect action.)
[/list]
And here is the list of implemented fixes and features:

[Feature] Added more detailed information to the Province Summary and Points panel in Team Mode.
[Feature] Introduced 24 brand-new Steam achievements to unlock.
[QoL] Updated recommended number of players for Ionium Reduci map.
[QoL] Added outlines to Colonists and cities on the map for better visibility.
[QoL] Increased camera zoom-out range on Aegyptus and Germania maps.
[QoL] Minor AI improvements on the Germania map.
[QoL-Controller] Added vibration feedback at the start of each turn.
[Fix] Fixed the skip Colonist buying animation in the tutorial.
[Fix] Fixed the undo of a Prefect action in the tutorial.
[Fix] Updated localization for improved language support.
[Fix] Fixed issues with selecting options from Architect/Prefect cards when using the Sextus Pompeius forum tile.
[Fix] Corrected an error that occurred when playing the Mamilius tile on the Germania map.
[Fix] Fixed a bug that caused an inability to choose a personality when the Magister card was played immediately after a card with multiple personalities.
[Fix] Resolved an issue where the icon of the last card played was incorrect after loading the game.
[Fix] Fixed player color discrepancies in the Diplomat card selection window.
[Fix] Fixed artifacts in the recruitment animation.
[Fix] Corrected tree animation issues.
[Fix] Removed beta content settings.
[Fix] Resolved display issues with the Publius forum tile (cost display and warning popup).
[Fix] Fixed Magister action with double personality cards and adjusted Magister card animations.
[Fix] Improved automatically selects add-ons based on the last game played.
[Fix] Fixed camera movement range when zooming with pinch gestures on the touch screen.
[Fix] Minor stability and performance improvements.
[Fix-Controller] Fixed gamepad controller focus after closing the pause menu during the tutorial.
[Fix-Controller] Fixed confirmation and skip functions for Roman fortresses on the Germania map.
[Fix-Controller] Improved text for the final step of the tutorial when using a gamepad controller.

[b] [url=https://t.co/S1jKeUFBtu][b]Discord server[/b][/url] - [url=https://twitter.com/acramdigital/]X[/url][/b] - [b][url=https://www.facebook.com/acramdigital]Facebook[/url][/b] - [b][url=https://www.youtube.com/@acramdigital6748]YouTube[/url][/b]

notes.title: Get ready for a major update for Concordia: Digital Edition!
notes.content:
Get ready for a major update for [b]Concordia: Digital Edition[/b]! Make sure to finish all your solo and multiplayer games by [b]October 22nd[/b] to avoid losing your progress. Before we roll it out, there's some important information to keep in mind. 👇

This update introduces key changes, making old game saves incompatible and inaccessible. Any attempt to load these older saves will fail. We are dedicated to offering long-term support for our game, ensuring seamless cross-platform compatibility for the best experience. In order to make it possible, we had to implement some breaking changes. 🗓️

On the bright side, the patch will bring exciting new features and fixes, including [b]Steam achievements[/b]! So, wrap up your current games, safeguard your progress, and prepare yourself for the great trading adventure! 🥳

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/5965f9a8fd6cc0bd00b1c02d24e882af5196a7da.png[/img]

notes.title: 🏛️ Venus is here! 🌿
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/14f9e51e055e821defff898a4e9c6d61ea20cc63.jpg[/img]

We are happy to announce that the very last DLC for Concordia: Digital Edition is now released!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/ca86f07b5eface78f1e1bb9f70ec0c7e533a2a05.jpg[/img]

[b][h1]🌿 What can you expect from Venus?🌿 [/h1][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/fea002e99bcf0982b7e9bc960af8db23025a246f.png[/img]
The most important feature is Teamplay Mode - with Venus you and your friend can partner up to compete with other teams in up to 6 players mode! And that's not all! 

[h2][b]⚖️ Teamplay Mode ⚖️[/b][/h2]
Join forces with your friends in business endeavors in ancient Rome!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/10f042acd403dd43b838754a2f30df19cbe80797.png[/img]

🌿 Venus offers players a team variant of classic Concordia for 4 to 6 players divided into teams of two. The team partners win and lose together and are affected by each other’s actions.

[h2][b]🗺️ New maps! 🗺️[/b][/h2]
That's right - the DLC contains 3 new maps! 

🌿 [b]Ionium [/b]is a map with two variants - a large 30 City map and a small 22 City map, which introduces a land bridge between the ancient cities of Brundisium and Apollonia; Land Colonists can cross it, but can not stay on that connection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/2e9291eb7e95467185c4156ea9aafa5da4deff05.png[/img]

🌿 [b]Hellas [/b]is a medium-sized map with 25 Cities and 10 Provinces and no additional rules

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/ca53f1b355409dc144118f739fc5a5f6e8921a30.png[/img]

[h1]With Venus, Season Pass is complete![/h1]
It was a long journey but now we are at its end! With Venus, the Season Pass is complete! We would like to [b]thank all of you for this amazing dive into ancient Rome [/b]- no matter if you had the Season Pass from the very beginning or you just bought it today! For now, we are not planning on releasing any more DLCs for Concordia but this might change in the future. :) Is there anything you would like us to work on? [b]Let us know in the comments![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/6fdbd095be97368e44bcca5bc93f312bd3844be8.jpg[/img]

Don't let this awesome DLC miss you! [b]Grab your friends and play Venus together![/b] Teamplay Mode  is on! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1707532/Concordia_Digital_Edition__Venus/

If you are a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1708670/Concordia_Digital_Edition__Season_Pass]Season Pass[/url] owner - congratulations, you now have Venus unlocked! Go play! 🙂

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1708670/Concordia_Digital_Edition__Season_Pass

[h1][b]We also have an update for you![/b][/h1]

As promised we keep fixing any issues that stop your trading empire in Concordia: Digital Edition from expanding! Check out what we changed this time!

[b][Feature] Venus has been released![/b]

[Fix] Card's artwork is now correctly displayed in the Cards Bank.
[Fix] Personality Card description is now correctly displayed on the Player's Information screen.
[Fix] Issues with "any goods" purchases displayed have been fixed.
[Fix] Controller controls have been improved.
[Fix] Venus rules described in the Rulebook have been improved.
[Fix] Cards are now properly displayed in the Rulebook.
[Fix] Confirm button's size has been increased.
[Fix] Card details are now easier to access.
[Fix] Localization update.
[Fix] App notifications have been updated.

[b]That's all for today! Keep expanding your Roman Trading Empire on new lands! ;)[/b]

Cheers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/26b52c94a0ca1e4e5f8ee4ec9da045ffd3fdb5b2.png[/img]

notes.title: 🐟 Fish Market and Britannia & Germania are officially out! 🗺️
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/6896daa18ab60819ebc215afe2782e9bb4f7e4dd.jpg[/img]

[h1]Our dear Players - today we have some amazing news for you![/h1]

As of today, both [b][url=acram.eu/assets/Common/red_dev.php?acruri=store.steampowered.com%2Fapp/1707531/Concordia_Digital_Edition__Fish_Market/&utm_source=mailing&utm_medium=steamsp&utm_campaign=releasefishmarketsp]"Fish Market"[/url][/b] and[b] [url=acram.eu/assets/Common/red_dev.php?acruri=store.steampowered.com%2Fapp/1707535/Concordia_Digital_Edition__Britannia__Germania/&utm_source=mailing&utm_medium=steamsp&utm_campaign=releasefishmarketsp]"Britannia & Germania"[/url][/b] DLCs are available for everyone to purchase! 🎲  3 new maps and exciting mechanics are waiting for you right now! Let us know what you think about these DLCs on our [url=acram.eu/assets/Common/red_dev.php?acruri=facebook.com%2Fgroups/315421659554830&utm_source=mailing&utm_medium=link&utm_campaign=concordia_grupa&utm_content=grupa]Facebook[/url] and [url=acram.eu/assets/Common/red_dev.php?acruri=discord.gg%2FwFf9B3KXzj&utm_source=mailing&utm_medium=link&utm_campaign=discord&utm_content=discord]Discord[/url]! :map: What's more general experience on Steam Deck has improved!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/8baffe4bbe294ea5ce851784e32042657bd00737.png[/img]
[h1]What can you expect in "[url=acram.eu/assets/Common/red_dev.php?acruri=store.steampowered.com%2Fapp/1707531/Concordia_Digital_Edition__Fish_Market/&utm_source=mailing&utm_medium=steamsp&utm_campaign=releasefishmarketsp]Fish Market[/url]"?[/h1]

This expansion contains two additional maps - Balearica and Cyprvs - and the Fish Market variant that add variety and new challenges to the game:

🐟 Fish Market is an alternative variant of the game that changes the mechanics of Bonus Goods, replaces Prefectus Magnus with Prefectus Piscatus, adds Fish as a trading Good, and a whole new Fish Market phase!
🗺️ Balearica is a 22 City map with 9 Provinces and no Capital City. Colonists initially start at sea and later are recruited in player-controlled Cities. In addition, this map changes the Sea movement mechanics.
🗺️ Cyprvs is a large 30 City map with 12 Provinces. While it doesn’t introduce any additional mechanics the number of Cities and Provinces poses a whole new challenge in itself!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1707531/Concordia_Digital_Edition__Fish_Market?snr=1_7_15__13

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/59af9204c943dee42a1994ac603c67446534e43f.jpg[/img]
[h1]What can you expect in "[url=acram.eu/assets/Common/red_dev.php?acruri=store.steampowered.com%2Fapp/1707535/Concordia_Digital_Edition__Britannia__Germania/&utm_source=mailing&utm_medium=steamsp&utm_campaign=releasefishmarketsp]Britannia & Germania[/url]"?[/h1]

This expansion contains two additional maps - Britannia and Germania - that add variety and new challenges to the game. Each map provides its own twist and a unique mechanic.

🗺️ Britannia is a 23 City map with 10 Provinces. Land and Sea Colonists have separate starting points and you can recruit new Colonists in every City with your House in it.
🗺️ Germania is a large 30 City map with 12 provinces and a number of additional rules. It introduces Roman castles that grant additional bonuses via the Tribune and Sea colonists traverse the rivers - and more than one can occupy the same one.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1707535/Concordia_Digital_Edition__Britannia__Germania?snr=1_7_15__13

notes.title: Salsa DLC is out!
notes.content:
[h1]The long awaited first major DLC for Concordia: Digital Edition is now available for purchase! [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/ace1ce32219990cb0b05c28ed1f4c5063a536072.jpg[/img]
 
As of now you can access [b]Salt [/b]and [b]Forum [/b]modules, and [b]Hispania [/b]and [b]Byzantium[/b] maps on [b]iOS[/b], [b]Android[/b], [b]Steam[/b], and [b]GOG[/b]!

[b]Salt[/b] is a new kind of trading good that can not be bought or sold - it can only be acquired from Salt producing cities. It's also the most valuable of all the trading goods, as it can serve as any other good for the purposes of house construction or points scoring!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/0d91ee370eba5be96bfa58b32c3b4ecd4c70ebc9.png[/img]

[b]Forum [/b]is a mechanic bringing a whole new set of Forum Cards, where you get patricians and regular citizens to help you throughout the game. The bonuses they provide are either a one-time use powerful ability or an ongoing change to core game mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/30956dab5c2f60887dfd374f4412f7011e06a78e.png[/img]

[b]Hispania & Byzantium[/b] are the two maps that come with the [b]Salsa DLC[/b]. They don't bring any new mechanics by themselves, but the different layout in itself will significantly impact the gameplay and the tactics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/6bda6cb100f1ac2cea9273c71529f313963bcdd4.png[/img]

[h1]Last call for the tournament![/h1]

Don't forget you can still sign up for the [b]Concordia: Digital Edition Online Tournament![/b]
 
All you need is the base game of Concordia and the will to compete! The event is completely [b]free of charge[/b] and there are [b]real prizes to be won[/b] provided by us (Acram Digital) and PD-Verlag - the publisher of the tabletop Concordia! 

More information [b]here[/b].

notes.title: Update ver. 1.1.0 - Live Play
notes.content:
The long-awaited full first patch is live and with it some noticeable changes based on your very own feedback! 

Most noticeable of which will be the different map views (accessible from the game itself) and the Live Play option for the online play (aka synchronous mode) - where the game needs to be played in one sitting.

Here's the full list of changes: 

[list]
[*] [Map] Added map options - toggle lower saturation view and House construction cost on and off.
[*] [Colonist] Colonists should be contrasting better in the Perspective (3D) Mode. We're still working on 3D Colonist models, so those are yet to come.
[*] [Camera] You can now toggle camera following your opponents' moves on or off. 
[*] [Online] We have added Live Play online game mode, where players agree to play the entire game in one sitting. Leaving the room means forfeiting. In case of disconnect - you have 3 minutes to come back.
[*] [Audio] Added production sound, end turn sound and new music!
[*] [Fix] All players will now properly see the Good-to-Sestertii conversion window at the end of an online game. 
[*] [Fix] Fixed dropdown menu view. 
[*] [Fix] Fixed the tooltip when waiting for your turn.
[*] [Fix] Fixed the rotating animation of the Player icon when they need to make a decision (considering) in the online game.
[*] [Fix] Fixed the 2D colonist animation during a replay.
[*] [Fix] Point calculation animation will not trigger multiple times when someone leaves the room in an online game.
[*] [Fix] Fixed a bug where we couldn't select any Goods with an overflowing Storehouse during a Prefect action.
[*] [Fix] Chat button will no longer be showing up in the Tutorial.
[*] [Fix] Fixed the podium display for 4th, 5th and 6th place.
[*] [UI/UX] Improved the visibility of your own Points.
[*] [Rulebook] Added icons to the Online Play section. Added Live Play to the rulebook's Online Play section.
[*] [Fix] Fixed the points visibility module. Now it actually hides the points.
[*] [Fix] Fixed a rare bug where we couldn't make our move when making a decision during someone else's turn.
[/list]


This is a repost of a previous patch - update done for better visibility - given it's an important update!

notes.title: You can now opt-in (and out) of Beta as you wish!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/85756ec73ebd053e11906cdeda2eafefd8fdc6a2.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hey guys - big news. We have decided to open the, uh, Open Beta channels on Steam and Google Play.[/h1] 

Unfortunately Apple does not offer such option on iOS. 

The general idea is that, based on your extensive and much appreciated post-launch feedback - we're introducing changes and new features. In order to make sure that: 
a) everything works well
b) everything works as you had in mind when requesting those features... 

...[b]you can now opt in and out of beta tracks as you wish. [/b]

On Google Play you need to go to the app page on your Google Play app where you can opt-in (or out) of the testing. Or you can follow this link: https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.acram.Concordia 

On Steam, you right click Concordia on your list of games, go to properties, then Betas. You should be able to find the beta branch in the drop-down menu there. The game will download a small patch each time you opt-in or out, but you can do that freely.

This going in-and-out is particularly important because, amongst other things, we're introducing the Live Play online game mode, and the online play servers are separate between the current Beta branch and the live patch that we have. So when in Beta, you won't see your normal online games, and vice versa (but you can just jump back and everything will be as you left it. 

Here's the list of changes we're proposing in the 1.0.5 Beta branch available on Steam and Google Play: 
[list]
[*] [Map] Added map options - toggle lower saturation view and House construction cost on and off.
[*] [Colonist] Colonists should be contrasting better in the Perspective (3D) Mode. We're still working on 3D Colonist models, so those are yet to come.
[*] [Camera] You can now toggle camera following your opponents' moves on or off. 
[*] [Online] We have added Live Play online game mode, where players agree to play the entire game in one sitting. Leaving the room means forfeiting. In case of disconnect - you have 3 minutes to come back.
[/list]

And here's some bugfixes, for good measure: 
[list]
[*] [Fix] All players will now properly see the Good-to-Sestertii conversion window at the end of an online game. 
[*] [Fix] Fixed dropdown menu view. 
[*] [Fix] Fixed the tooltip when waiting for your turn.
[*] [Fix] Fixed the rotating animation of the Player icon when they need to make a decision (considering) in the online game.
[*] [Fix] Fixed the 2D colonist animation during a replay.
[*] [Fix[ Point calculation animation will not trigger multiple times when someone leaves the room in an online game.
[*] [Fix] Fixed a bug where we couldn't select any Goods with an overflowing Storehouse during a Prefect action.
[*] [Fix] Chat button will no longer be showing up in the Tutorial.
[*] [Fix[ Fixed the podium display for 4th, 5th and 6th place.
[/list]

You can, of coruse, report any feedback here on Steam, but feel free to join our discord as well!
https://discord.gg/mZnrRrBw

notes.title: The second patch, v1.0.3.1 is live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/a8fb2f00a1a7cb4908ddb9103b98d6379a298627.png[/img]


[b]The second patch, v1.0.3.1 is live![/b]

We've patched up a couple of bugs and introduce a few changes to the camera behaviour. We've updated the end game animations as well and (we believe) they are much fancier now :)

The Live Game mode is now in beta testing and we hope to release it in the very next patch. Keep your finger crossed! We're still working on improving the visibility of the board elements as well. 

Onto the changelog!
[list]
[*] [Shiny] New end game scoring animations. The screen should, if nothing else, look more engaging now.
[*] [UI/UX] Aquilea City name graphic receives a lifting for improved visibility.
[*] [UI/UX] We added tooltips in various places throughout the game and the menus.
[*] [UI/UX][PC only] Added a checkbox to turn edge scrolling on/off.
[*] [UX/Camera] From now on you can move a camera during opponent's moves animation in order to stop the campera from jumping around. Where you place it - it will stay.
[*] [UX/Camera] Increased the max zoom-out distance on larger screens. Larger meaning tablets, laptops, desktops, etc. Everything above 6 inches.
[*] [UI] Improvements to UI visibility on mobile devices. Most notably: the PM icon, the hand of Cards, fixes to the 2D Colonists.
[*] [Fix] Fixed a bug with graphics not loading properly on PC with system language set to Turkish.
[*] [Fix] Fixed a bug where during the replay, the view jumped between different players' perspectives.
[*] [Fix] Fixed a bug where during the replay, the screen with information about the last played card remained on the screen.
[*] [Fix] Fixed a bug where the player couldn't choose a color when joining an empty room (online).
[*] [Fix] Fixed the tooltip about trying to build more than 15 Houses. Now it shows up after the 15th House, not before.
[*] [Fix] Colonists inside the City will no longer be clickable (as they shouldn't).
[/list]

Don't forget to join our community on FB and share your feedback about the game! https://www.facebook.com/groups/concordiadigitaledition/

notes.title: The first post-release patch, v.1.0.2 is live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/e22e9caa64bafe5b7c80030e6420dd159d8e6008.png[/img]


[b]The first patch, v1.0.2 is live![/b]

First of all - thank you for all the feedback. We've patched up couple of bugs, and we're working hard on incorporating some QOL changes based on your most requested features - like Live Game mode for online play or increased visibility of certain game elements. 

So, in short - keep the feedback flowing, your voice does matter. 

Onto the changelog!
[list]
[*] [PC/Mac Only][Fix] Fixed the missing localization of the confirm button in the Resolution options screen.
[*] [PC/Mac Only][Fix] Fixes to the controller navigation in the Tutorial
[*] [Fix] Fixed the visual bug with "disappearing" discarded cards after a Senator action (buying a card).
[*] [Fix] Fixed the occiasional crash after constructing the last House in certain languages (i.e. Italian)
[*] [Fix] Fixed the occasional crash in the tutorial.
[*] [Fix] Fixed the occasional crash when leaving the game.
[*] [Fix] Fixed the navigation using the pop-up messages in the online play. 
[*] [Fix] Numerous small fixes to the display of Players Panel when moving between games.
[*] [Fix] Several typos amended.
[*] [UI/UX] Colonists should now be more visible on the map.
[*] [UI/UX] Added a warning after selecting an inactive Province during a Prefect action.
[*] [UI/UX] Small improvements to the Colonists visibility in the colorblind mode. 
[/list]

Don't forget to join our community on FB and share your feedback about the game! https://www.facebook.com/groups/concordiadigitaledition/
